chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man around 28 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.DAUGHTER: a shy young Moroccan woman around 22 wearing a loose long lilac dress and a cream headscarf
chars.LANDLADY: a plump cheerful Moroccan woman around 50 wearing a green house djellaba with gold trim and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the doorway of a small rented room at the bottom of a traditional Moroccan house staircase with zellige tiles, DAUGHTER holds out a tray with a steaming tagine and bread to NARRATOR, eyes lowered shyly; up on the stairs behind her LANDLADY peeks around the corner with a cheeky smile. Warm evening light, playful mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands frozen in his doorway, holding the tray, nervously scratching the back of his head, too shy to speak, blushing. Simple rented room in a Moroccan house behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: DAUGHTER walks carefully down a narrow tiled Moroccan staircase carrying a plate of couscous with both hands, glancing down toward a door at the bottom. Soft afternoon light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the doorway, DAUGHTER stares at NARRATOR with a dreamy shy smile, unable to look away, while NARRATOR awkwardly takes a glass of mint tea from her hands, looking embarrassed. Medium shot, both faces clearly visible in the upper-middle of the frame.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on a mattress in his small room holding a plate of food, looking toward the viewer with raised eyebrows and a puzzled half-smile, as if asking a question. Cosy Moroccan rented room.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the upper landing of a traditional Moroccan house, LANDLADY hands a tray of food to DAUGHTER and gently pushes her toward the stairs with a sly grin, while DAUGHTER looks back hesitant and embarrassed. Zellige walls, plants, warm light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: LANDLADY leans over the staircase railing above and gives a big knowing wink down at NARRATOR, who stands below in his doorway with wide eyes, suddenly realising her plan. Comic, playful mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Again DAUGHTER stands at NARRATOR's door holding a plate of fresh msemen pancakes and smiling shyly; NARRATOR opens the door looking surprised; in the background LANDLADY hides behind a curtain on the stairs, watching with an excited grin.
